what: reconciliation of the registered 204.0 s/cell against the ~1947 s mtime span, and the cost of a 2x2 in each body
method: per-cell optimisation wall-clock = mtime(history.txt) - mtime(config.scone). The three model/init files in each cell directory carry their SOURCE mtime (2026-08-08) because they are copied inputs, which is what made naive directory mtime spans read as 32 hours.

reconciliation.registered_204_s_per_cell: MEASURES optimisation wall-clock, control arm. Reproduced exactly: R151C mean 204.0 s (min 185.2, max 214.2, n=6).
reconciliation.the_~1947_s_span: MEASURES optimisation launch spread (429.7 s for R151C) PLUS the later .par.sto replay pass (mean 1743.2 s). Sum ~2173 s.
reconciliation.why_they_differ: they measure different things; the replay is a separate step run in later sessions
reconciliation.replay_spans_are_not_compute: R151S replay span is 221287 s = 61.5 h, which is calendar idle between sessions, not CPU. A replay is ONE forward simulation, i.e. about one objective evaluation: optimisation_time/(90 generations x ~17 population) is sub-second. Replay compute is negligible; its mtime span is unusable as a cost figure.
reconciliation.which_predicts_a_new_run: the optimisation wall-clock. Neither figure is CPU time; nothing on disk records CPU seconds, and cells within an arm were launched within ~430 s of each other so runs overlapped.

THE_INVERSION.measured: 2D is 1646.1 s/cell against 3D 147.6 s/cell = 11.2x MORE expensive per cell
THE_INVERSION.like_for_like: both 90 generations, 91 history lines; 2D simulates 10 s per trial against 3D 20 s
THE_INVERSION.cause: 2D runs ModelOpenSim4; 3D runs ModelHyfydy. The engine dominates, not the model size.
THE_INVERSION.consequence: 3D is the CHEAP body in this corpus. A 2D-first plan costs about 8x more than the same design in 3D.

cost_of_the_2x2.design: 2 missing arms (plantarflexor weakness, dorsiflexor reflex) x 3 dose points x 6 seeds = 36 cells
cost_of_the_2x2.note: wall-clock at observed concurrency; destabilising arms cost less because trials terminate early
